in_marathi.name: Lakshyansh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Lakshyansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Lakshyansh is a Sanskrit name for a baby boy. It is derived from the words 'lakshya' meaning 'goal' and 'ansh' meaning 'attainment'. The name symbolizes the attainment of one's goals and the pursuit of success. It is a powerful name that is believed to bring prosperity, happiness, and good fortune to the child.
